title: I Took the Airport Lounge Quiet-Zone Photo to Membership Services

parts.text: I sat in the quiet zone at 6:08 a.m. with a 7:40 connection and a man on speakerphone pitching a deck. The lounge map on the wall shaded our seats as quiet. I was forty-four, consultant, holding noise-canceling that could not cancel a pitch. Staff said they do not police calls. I photographed the map, his phone on speaker, and my membership card. Then I live-chatted membership with the photo. At 6:16 a lounge host asked him to move to the bar, and he pointed at me as the problem passenger.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He is pointing at me while the host holds the quiet-zone map.

social.video_title: Speakerphone pitch in the shaded quiet seats — Part 1/2
social.description: Connection at 7:40, a deck on speaker, staff would not police. Chat had the map. Would you have moved first?

parts.text: He moved to the bar and pitched the bartender. I got a lounge credit and a quieter row. Membership said hosts do police when photos exist. I boarded on time. The map still shades those seats. Speakerphone is a bar skill. Quiet is a membership bullet I actually wanted. I did not clap. I charged my laptop. The pitch faded into espresso steam, which is an improvement.

social.video_title: Hosts police when the map is in the chat — Part 2/2
social.description: Bar pitch, lounge credit, on-time board. Was a deck a quiet zone?
